name: Unscroll
subtitle: Instagram without the endless scroll
description:
Instagram without the endless scroll: no Reels, no Explore, no suggested posts — just the people you follow, their stories, and your DMs. Unscroll is Instagram's own website with those taken out, made to feel like an app.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Meta or Instagram.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Unscroll 2.5.14: the Hanami theme's camera button is pink too
• Hanami theme: pink camera button in chats, serif name on the feed
• Hanami theme: more pink again, a blush page and Hanami's pink pills

• Unscroll 2.5.13: Hanami theme (Settings → Look)
• Hanami theme: no background picture, a plain soft white page
• Hanami theme: subtler pink, mostly white and glass
• Hanami theme: Instagram in Hanami's look, a switch in Settings

• Unscroll 2.5.12: profiles, posts and other pages slide in as the app's own screens
• Unscroll 2.5.12: endless animations that relayout stay still, and ones just off screen pause
• Unscroll 2.5.12: page changes, chats and the DMs move sooner and quicker
• Unscroll 2.5.11: messages read from a tapped notification stay out of the next one
• Unscroll 2.5.10: back over a reel's comments in a chat closes the comments
• Unscroll 2.5.9: the keyboard stays open in a share sheet's search over the DMs
• Unscroll 2.5.8: chat notifications list each message once, and leave out those already read
• Unscroll 2.5.7: a chat's notification keeps every message you missed

• DMs: pull down at the top of the inbox to refresh, as on the feed

iPhone: the same page scripts; pulling the inbox to refresh needs a new iPhone build, so for now it is the feed only there.

• Stories: going back (a swipe right, or a tap back on someone's first story) goes to the person before, at the story you left them on, instead of skipping ahead or closing

iPhone: the same, on iOS 26 and later.
